FORMAT LAW. Honour the grammar of the seamless loop illusion — its native framing, its edit rhythm, and the specific thing audiences expect from it. If the format loops, the last frame must match the first.

CAMERA. Compose 9:16 with the action in the safe centre band. Use a parallax slide with strong foreground/background separation on a 70-200mm zoom at 150mm, framing with leading lines converging on the subject from the lower corners.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with bare-bulb specular light producing tight, hot speculars; grade as a punchy saturated candy palette with hard primaries. Specify the sound design in one clause — what the viewer hears in the first second decides whether they stay.

OUTPUT. Your entire reply is the prompt itself: one dense paragraph, no title, no quotation marks, no trailing notes.
